name: nipoppy2fedbiomed
description: Export tabular data from a Nipoppy study for a Fed-BioMed node.

inputs.name: nipoppy_root
inputs.description: Root directory of the Nipoppy study.

inputs.name: output_dir
inputs.description: Directory to write the CSV and JSON files to.

inputs.name: phenotype
inputs.description: Neurobagel TermURL of a phenotypic column in tabular/harmonized.tsv (e.g. nb:Age). Can be repeated.

inputs.name: derivative
inputs.description: Derivative TSV file to include, where FILEPATH_PATTERN is a glob pattern relative to the pipeline's derivatives directory (e.g. freesurfer:7.3.2:idp/*-aseg-volume.tsv). Can be repeated.

inputs.name: tag
inputs.description: Fed-BioMed dataset tag. Can be repeated.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Fed-BioMed dataset name. Default: name of the Nipoppy root directory.

inputs.name: dataset_path
inputs.description: Dataset path written to the JSON file, as seen by the Fed-BioMed node. Can start with an environment variable of the node (e.g. $NIPOPPY_ROOT/...). Default: absolute path of the CSV file.

inputs.name: help
inputs.description: show this help message and exit

groups.name: data_sources
groups.description: At least one phenotype or derivative must be specified
